column1: Alec Burleson stands out as the top pick, hitting third with a strong platoon advantage and a favorable park boost, making him a reliable option against Tanner Gordon. Jake McCarthy also offers consistency from the leadoff spot with a similar matchup edge and has recorded a hit in nearly three-quarters of his games. Jeremy Pena and Jordan Walker provide additional steady choices, but Burleson’s combination of order, matchup, and environment gives him the edge for Beat The Streak players.
